vendor: OpenBMB (Open Lab for Big Model Base) / Tsinghua University NLP Lab
product_family: ChatDev 2.0 (DevAll): Open-source zero-code multi-agent orchestration platform for LLM-powered workflow automation. Includes legacy ChatDev v1.0 for software development teams.

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type 1/2
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of SOC 2 certification. ChatDev is open-source software, not a commercial SaaS service, so SOC 2 does not apply to the project itself. Users' deployments are their own responsibility.

certifications.name: ISO 27001
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of ISO 27001 certification. ChatDev is open-source software. OpenBMB and affiliated organizations (Tsinghua University, BAAI) are not publicly documented as ISO 27001 certified.

certifications.name: GDPR Compliance
certifications.proof_quote: Not applicable. ChatDev is open-source software deployed on user infrastructure. No personal data processing by the vendor.

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: Not applicable. ChatDev is open-source software. Users deploying ChatDev in regulated environments (healthcare) are responsible for their own HIPAA compliance.

certifications.name: PCI DSS
certifications.proof_quote: Not applicable. ChatDev is open-source software. PCI DSS compliance depends on user deployment.

certifications.name: ISO 27017/27018 (Cloud Security)
certifications.proof_quote: Not applicable. ChatDev is open-source, user-deployed software, not a cloud service provided by the vendor.

privacy.ai_training_note: ChatDev is a multi-agent orchestration platform, not a model trainer. Users' workflows and data are not ingested by OpenBMB. Users can configure ChatDev to use third-party LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, etc.); compliance depends on which LLM provider is configured.

security.name: License & Open Source Audit
security.value: Apache 2.0 (permissive). Full source code available for review on GitHub. 199 commits, 73 contributors, 33.6k stars. Active development.

security.name: Self-Hosting Model
security.value: ChatDev is designed for self-hosting. Users deploy via Docker Compose, Python/uv, or direct Python execution. No vendor-managed SaaS infrastructure.

security.name: Encryption in Transit (TLS)
security.value: Depends on user deployment. Backend is FastAPI (Python), frontend is Vue 3. Users are responsible for TLS/HTTPS configuration in their own environment.

security.name: Data Storage
security.value: ChatDev includes YAML workflow configs and in-memory session data. No vendor-managed database. Users control where YAML files and workflow artifacts are stored. Artifacts are generated in local 'WareHouse/' directory.

security.name: Authentication
security.value: No built-in user authentication in open-source ChatDev. Users deploying ChatDev for multi-user access are responsible for adding authentication/authorization (via reverse proxy, IAM, etc.).

security.name: LLM API Keys
security.value: ChatDev requires users to provide LLM API keys (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, etc.). Keys are configured via .env file. Users are responsible for key rotation and secure storage.

products.name: ChatDev 2.0 (DevAll)
products.data_scope: Workflow YAML configs, workflow artifacts (generated code, data visualizations, 3D models), session logs. All user-controlled, locally stored.
products.notes: Zero-code platform. Users define agents, workflows, and tasks via YAML. Supports out-of-the-box templates for data visualization, 3D generation (Blender), game dev, deep research, and video generation.

products.name: ChatDev 1.0 (Legacy)
products.data_scope: Software development tasks, generated code, documentation. User-deployed.
products.notes: Moved to chatdev1.0 branch. Simulates a virtual software company with specialized agent roles (CEO, CTO, Programmer, Tester, etc.). No longer the primary focus.

products.name: ChatDev Python SDK
products.data_scope: Workflow execution via Python. Outputs and results handled by user code.
products.notes: PyPI package 'chatdev' (v0.1.0+). Users can orchestrate workflows programmatically rather than via the web console.

compare.pricing_model: Open-source (free). No commercial SaaS offering. Users pay for third-party LLM API usage (OpenAI, Anthropic, etc.) and infrastructure costs.
compare.data_residency: User-determined. ChatDev is deployed on user infrastructure. No vendor-managed cloud.

flags: ChatDev is NOT a commercial SaaS vendor. It is an open-source project. Traditional vendor compliance metrics (SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, DPA) do not apply to the open-source project itself.
Users deploying ChatDev are responsible for their own compliance. Compliance posture depends entirely on deployment context (on-premises, cloud, LLM provider choice).
No vendor trust center, security documentation, or privacy policy exists. This is normal for open-source projects.

LLM Provider Risk: ChatDev is configured to use third-party LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini). Users' workflows and prompts are sent to the configured LLM provider. Compliance with user's data policies depends on which LLM is selected and that provider's terms.
No built-in user authentication. Multi-user deployments require additional security controls (reverse proxy, IAM, etc.).
OpenBMB is academically affiliated (Tsinghua University, BAAI, Beijing) with a related commercial entity (ModelBest, founded 2022). ChatDev itself remains open-source.
